resolutions.title: The empty-commit check writes .git/index: `git diff --quiet HEAD --` refreshes the stat cache even under GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
resolutions.action: applied A′, a variant of option A: commit.ts runs the working-tree diff through PrRunner.diffWorktreeAgainstHead, which runs `git diff --quiet HEAD --` with GIT_INDEX_FILE naming a copy of the index in the OS temp directory and removes it after, so the repository's index is never written; the harness's engine() now fails any call that changes .git/index's bytes or mtime, shown able to fail on the old code and by an injected live-index diff; the requirement states the copy and the check, with a new scenario
resolutions.evidence: scratch repository: GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git diff --quiet HEAD -- rewrote .git/index; the same diff with GIT_INDEX_FILE on a copy exits 0 for MM restored and 1 for a real change, leaving .git/index untouched; git hash-object on a symlink hashes the target (f2ad6c7) not the link blob (4d1ae35), the flaw in option A as written. Mutation: dropping GIT_INDEX_FILE fails two tests
resolutions.resolution: A′: keep git diff --quiet HEAD -- but run it against a temporary copy of the index, and add a harness check that .git/index never changes across an engine call

options_presented.label: A
options_presented.body: Replace the worktree diff with a read-only per-path comparison: for each non-`??` porcelain entry, compare the HEAD blob and mode (`git ls-tree HEAD -- <paths>`) with the working-tree file's content hash (`git hash-object -- <path>`, never `-w`) and its presence and executable bit; add `hash-object` without `-w`/`--stdin` writes to the allowlist row and run.ts's gitAllowed, recapture the git contract, and keep the MM/AD and untracked-only tests.

options_presented.label: B
options_presented.body: Keep `git diff --quiet HEAD --` and amend the allowlist requirement to name the index stat-cache refresh as the one write `orbit pr commit` makes (content unchanged), with its index.lock interaction as a named limit.

options_presented.label: C
options_presented.body: Revert to printing the commit on any porcelain entry and make the MM/AD case a named limit: the printed commit fails with nothing to commit and the step-failure row shows the recovery (re-opening the external finding as a limit).
